example.title: Train-themed shop with a locomotive on its front (Choo Choo, San Diego)
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A c. 1990 single-storey shop: a grey and white stucco front with an enormous streamlined green steam-locomotive front bursting out of the wall, an oversized round sign and lettering along the fascia. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
